summary: Prosperity Bancshares filed an 8-K reporting receipt of all required regulatory approvals (Federal Reserve Bank of Dallas, FDIC, Texas Department of Banking) for its pending merger with Stellar Bancorp. The merger, governed by a January 27, 2026 agreement, involves Stellar merging into Prosperity followed by the bank merger. Stellar shareholders will vote on May 27, 2026, with closing expected around July 1, 2026. No price/share or premium disclosed. The transaction is now awaiting only shareholder approval, making the risk-arb focus on the vote outcome and any potential last-minute conditions.
